Path: reports · 经营数字对得上:系统总览与分析立方体 | 缺项 (no `dashboards` item asserts that an inline dataset leaves the authored cube other users read unchanged) | P2

## Triage: first grade — `bug` · `security` · `priority:p1` · `domain:services` · `area:reports` · `pm:queue`

Triage: lands in `packages/services/service-analytics/src/analytics-service.ts`, read on `origin/main` `29720975`. `queryDataset` (`:1452`) calls `registerDataset` (`:1426`) as its first statement. That call writes the process-wide `this.cubeRegistry.register(compiled.cube)` (`:1441`) and `this.datasetRegistry.set(dataset.name, …)` before any admission runs ⇒ `domain:services`.

Rationale: NORTH-STAR 〈优先级〉 rule 1 (安全与数据完整性永远最高,不等路). With one request, any authenticated member replaces the authored cube every other user reads, until restart. The request can be one the platform refuses with 403. The same request re-publishes a name the author hid. No row leaves the caller's RLS scope, and a restart restores the cubes, so this is not P0 ⇒ **p1**. This seat did not re-run the transcript. The source reading agrees with step 2: registration comes before admission.

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-09-28T03:03Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Read: this card (no comments) and the two methods above.

**Duplicate check.** Corpus: 6,168 objectstack issues and PRs updated since 2026-09-01T00:00Z, all states. Titles and bodies were matched on `registerDataset|cubeRegistry.register|inline dataset|CubeRegistry` together with `overwrit|replac|collid|collision|clobber|shared registry|process-wide`. That gives 4 hits, and none is this overwrite:
- PR #20348 is where this was found;
- #20119 and #17559 are other analytics defects;
- #18549 is a seat post.

Control: `queryDataset` alone gives 33 hits.

**Serial constraint: PR #20348** (#20282, `domain:spec` seat 2, in flight) edits the same `analytics-service.ts`.
- Claim after it lands, or declare it in the claim.
- Step 4 here (resurrecting a hidden name) undoes #20282's `public: false`. So the hidden-cube pin below is only meaningful on top of #20348.

**Execution notes.**
1. A `queryDataset` call must not write the shared registries.
   - Compile per request, and hand the compiled dataset to the executor directly.
   - Boot-time registration of saved datasets (`:943`) stays.
   - Measure whether the join allowlist or `DatasetExecutor` reads the registry by name; don't assume it.
2. Admission runs before any compile side effect.
3. A refusal of an inline name that collides with an authored cube is **not** required by this card. Once nothing is shared, a collision is harmless. A new refusal on a public door is a door-shape change that needs its own ruling. ⛔ Don't add one here.
4. Pin through the real route (`bootStack`, two sign-ups):
   - a refused inline dataset leaves user B's `meta` and query unchanged;
   - an admitted inline dataset leaves them unchanged too;
   - a `public: false` cube stays hidden;
   - control: a saved dataset registered at boot still serves.

Size/model suggestion: M · one service file plus a route-level pin.

Claim: PM loop round 1

Plus a route-level pin through `@objectstack/verify` `bootStack` wherever the package's existing route tests live, and `.changeset/20356-*.md`. ⛔ No `packages/spec` (a new refusal on this door is out of scope per triage, execution note 3). ⛔ No change to boot-time registration of saved datasets (`:943`). (Stop on breach; explain in the report.)
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (`dispatch-gates --tier`: no path-derived mandate, floor sonnet · default opus · ceiling fable)
Clause-②: no
Thread-read: 5862512472
Serial constraints cleared: read at 2026-09-28T03:43Z on `origin/main` `a88a1bb3`.
- **DECLARED OVERLAP: PR #20348** (#20282, `domain:spec` seat 2) is a draft, in flight, head `f84cd184`. It edits `analytics-service.ts` (+32/−4), `cube-registry.ts` and `dataset-compiler.ts`, plus about 45 one-line edits in `service-analytics` tests.
  - This is ordinary concurrency, not a single-claim path: the later lander resolves the conflict.
  - This round works off `origin/main`, and merges `main` again if #20348 lands first.
  - The hidden-cube pin (triage note 4, third leg) is meaningful only on top of #20348's `public: false`. If #20348 has not landed when this PR is ready, that leg is written against the merged tree after it lands, or is declared NOT MEASURABLE on `main`, never faked.
- No other open PR touches `packages/services/service-analytics/src/`. The last same-lane commit on the package is `ab820016` (#20232, this seat's).

<sub>`Clause-②: no`: the change removes a side effect (an inline dataset writing into the shared registries), and adds no accept-set widening and no new public surface. Triage note 3 keeps a collision refusal out of this card. Security-family disclosure discipline (lane rule): the PR and its comments describe the defect and the fix abstractly, with no step-by-step reproduction beyond what the pins encode.</sub>

## ACCEPT: PR #20380 at `15e21b98` (closes #20356)

`domain:services` seat (#6021) · `session_01TEah6PeJGjxJfbHaySJjLQ` · 2026-09-28T04:54Z. Review of report `5863662331` against GitHub and `origin/main`.

**Review items**
1. **PR shape.** Draft; base `main`. The head lines are `Fixes #20356` / `Clause-②: no`. A full-body scan finds that as the only closing keyword, and there is one footer. The body describes the defect and the fix at the code-path level, with no request recipe (the lane's security disclosure discipline).
2. **Scope.** 7 files, +738 / −60: `analytics-service.ts`, `cube-registry.ts` (comments), `dataset-compiler.ts`, two new test files, one edited test, and the changeset (`patch`, `Clause-②: no`). No `packages/spec`, no `content/docs/releases/**`. Boot-time registration (`config.cubes` / `config.datasets`) is untouched.
   - **Surface revision:**
     - the route pin lives in `packages/qa/dogfood/test/`, where the package's `bootStack` route tests live;
     - `dataset-i18n-label-resolution.test.ts` is edited, because one case asserted the removed registration side effect; its intent is kept.
     Both are recorded here as the revised claim surface.
3. **The premise, re-read on `origin/main` `a88a1bb3`.** `queryDataset` (`:1452`) called `registerDataset` (`:1458`), which writes `cubeRegistry` / `datasetRegistry` (`:1441-1442`) before any admission. The fix makes `queryDataset` compile only, and runs every name-keyed read on the query path through a request `CubeScope`.
4. **Measured assumptions.**
   - (1) is partly falsified, and the falsification is accepted: `ensureCube`'s augmentation was a second request-time shared write reachable from a dataset call. It is now request-scoped and pinned.
   - (2) and (3) are confirmed.
   - (4): the hidden-cube leg is NOT MEASURABLE on `main` (nothing reads `Cube.public` there). What is pinned instead is registry identity plus B's whole `meta` equalling B's baseline. It is declared, not faked.
5. **Tests.**
   - Unit: 12 cases (6 legs × 2 strategies). The refusal legs assert `PERMISSION_DENIED` / 403.
   - Route: 10 cases (5 legs × `sqlite-wasm` / `memory`), `bootStack` with two sign-ups.
   - Ablations A (unit), B (unit) and A (route, through `dist`, with preflight marker present and then absent) all go red, and every restore is proven.
   - `service-analytics`: 130 files / 3053 tests. Gates: 66 derived / 66 run / 0 NOT-MEASURED.
6. **CI on `15e21b98`** at review time: 15 success, 3 skipped, 14 running. This is not a landing read.

**The dev's out-of-scope finding (class a, reach measured)** is filed as **#20381** (bare, for triage). The ad-hoc `/analytics/query` and `/analytics/sql` doors write inferred and augmented cubes into the shared registry before admission, so a refused request still changes every member's `meta`. It is the same family, and it is left out of this PR by design. The other two notes stay in the PR's Acceptance notes.

**Cross-seat:** the `assertCubePublic` merge hazard with PR #20348 is posted on #20282 (`5863707173`). Whichever PR lands later must make that check read `scope.getCube(name)`.

**Landing to-dos, recorded now:**
1. The at-tier contract review on the CI-green head. It is owed on this surface: `.changeset` prose.
2. Only on PASS: `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 20380`, the merge-state read, then `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable` through the relay, confirmed by `added_to_merge_queue`.
3. After MERGED on `origin/main`: close out #20356.
